gloss: the back (of a building); rear side; back area

definitions.gloss: the back (of a building); rear side; back area
definitions.explanation: The physical area behind a building or structure. Used to describe the rear or back side of locations, typically in giving directions or describing spatial relationships.

examples.japanese: {建物|たてもの}の{裏手|うらて}に{回|まわ}る。
examples.english: Go around to the back of the building.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{裏手|うらて}に{小|ちい}さな{公園|こうえん}がある。
examples.english: There is a small park behind the station.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{裏手|うらて}には{山|やま}が{広|ひろ}がっていて、{自然|しぜん}が{豊|ゆた}かだった。
examples.english: Behind the school, mountains stretched out, and the area was rich in nature.

notes:
Refers to the back or rear side of a building, structure, or location. Typically used for the physical area behind something rather than an abstract concept.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建物|たてもの}の{裏手|うらて}: the back of a building
- {家|いえ}の{裏手|うらて}: behind the house
- {裏手|うらて}に{回|まわ}る: to go around to the back
- {裏手|うらて}に{出|で}る: to come out at the back

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {裏側|うらがわ}: reverse side — can be used for flat objects as well as buildings
- {裏|うら}: back — more general; also means the hidden or reverse side of things
- {背面|はいめん}: rear surface — more formal and technical
